policy.notes: Pipe-only collection; use optional follow-up collection for other metric families.

optimization_directions.action: Inspect whether the dominant pipe and arithmetic mix match the intended Ascend C execution path before changing tiling or compute code.
optimization_directions.impact_basis: Timing evidence is corroborated by PipeUtilization and ArithmeticUtilization signals.
optimization_directions.title: Inspect Pipe And Arithmetic Mix

optimization_directions.action: Inspect GM/UB/L0 movement and DataCopy feeding around the timed path before changing buffering or tile reuse.
optimization_directions.impact_basis: Timing evidence is corroborated by pipe and memory/cache movement signals.
optimization_directions.title: Inspect Memory And Data Movement

optimization_directions.action: Inspect UB layout, queue schedule, and conflicting resource usage around the timed path before changing kernel structure.
optimization_directions.impact_basis: Timing evidence is corroborated by ResourceConflictRatio and another operator-level metric family.
optimization_directions.title: Inspect UB Or Resource Conflict
